subject: Data Processing Addendum — MBridge Systems (DPA redlines & sign-off)
messages:

To: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@mbridgesys.com
Date: 2026-05-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Data Processing Addendum and SCCs for upcoming contract

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is excited to move forward. Our legal and procurement teams asked me to request Redwood's Data Processing Addendum and any standard SCC language you use (we operate across EU & US). We also have a short retention/backup question and a HIPAA scoping question for one of our integrations.

Could you share your standard DPA and indicate if you can accept customer-proposed redlines? Also, if you have a current SOC 2 report and subprocessor list, that would speed review.

I've attached our preferred DPA counters and a short procurement checklist. Let me know if a redline review call would help.

Attachments: MBridge_DPA_Counters_v1.docx, MBridge_Procurement_Checklist.pdf

Best,
Sofia Alvarez
Director, Procurement
MBridge Systems

Date: 2026-05-13T11:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Data Processing Addendum and SCCs for upcoming contract

Hi Sofia — thanks for the note and great to hear the team liked the demo.

I'm attaching our standard Data Processing Addendum (RWI_DataProcessingAddendum_v1.docx). We are happy to review your counters — our legal team typically responds with a redline within 2 business days for commercial customers. For SOC 2, I'll share the secure report link once legal confirms the appropriate NDA gating. We can also provide our subprocessor list.

If it's helpful, I can set a 30-minute redline call tomorrow afternoon (Thu) so our counsel can walk through the key asks (data residency, retention, HIPAA scoping). What time works for you?

Cheers,
Aditya Rao

aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachment: RWI_DataProcessingAddendum_v1.docx
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-05-14T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: RWI DPA — initial redline and flagged clauses

Aditya / Marissa —

Thanks, looping in our legal ops lead for execution notes (Marissa). I reviewed MBridge's counters and prepared a redline with commentary. High-level items to note:

- Data residency: MBridge requests EU-only processing for a scoped set of EU customer data. We can offer an EU-hosted model variant but need to clarify which model endpoints they will use.
- SCCs: We accept the standard EU SCCs but will attach our vendor annex; procurement should confirm their signatory authority.
- HIPAA scoping: Their counters ask for Business Associate Agreement (BAA) style language. We support HIPAA for specific workloads under Redwood Dedicated/Private — we need to confirm which deployment they will use before accepting BAA terms.
- Retention: We propose a 90-day default log retention with an option for a longer contractual retention for specific data types — redline reflects that.

I've attached my tracked changes: RWI_DPA_Redline_neha.docx. Please review and confirm whether we should accept the MBridge edits on residency and the retention carveout.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: RWI_DPA_Redline_neha.docx
From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@mbridgesys.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@mbridgesys.com
Date: 2026-05-15T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RWI DPA — initial redline and flagged clauses

Aditya — thanks for the quick response and Neha for the redline. We reviewed and counters in-line; key asks below:

- We need EU processing for EU-sourced PHI (the integration will touch EU patient contact data). Please confirm you can guarantee EU-only processing for that workload.
- BAA: we prefer BAA-style language included in the DPA rather than a separate instrument.
- Retention: propose a 30-day default for non-essential logs, 365 days for transactional records; we can carve out analytics logs.
- Exec signature: procurement wants DPA signed by an authorized exec on both sides; we'll route to our Director of Legal once terms are agreed.

I've attached our counterparty redline (MBridge_DPA_Counters_v1.docx). We can do a call on Mon to finalize.

Sofia Alvarez
Director, Procurement
MBridge Systems

Attachment: MBridge_DPA_Counters_v1.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sofia.alvarez@mbridgesys.com
Date: 2026-05-16T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Execution plan and signer map for MBridge DPA

Hi all —

Thanks for the context. Proposed plan to keep momentum:

1) Confirm scope: Aditya / Neha to confirm whether EU-only processing can be scoped to the specific integration (and if Dedicated/Private is required for HIPAA workloads).
2) Finalize redline: Neha to accept or propose tweaks to MBridge counters on retention and executive signatory.
3) Signature routing: once final, we'll use DocuSign. Our usual sign flow for DPAs is: Redwood Legal Ops (signature block: VP Legal) -> Redwood CFO (if required by value) -> Customer Director of Legal -> Customer CFO. If MBridge wants exec-level signoff, we'll allow the Director-level signatories; please confirm names & titles.
4) Evidence: I'll share SOC 2 auditor report link under NDA and maintain the subprocessor list.

If that plan works, I will prepare the DocuSign envelope request and include the signed DPA + exhibit A (subprocessors). Estimated time to complete: 3–5 business days after final agreement.

Marissa Cole
Legal Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@mbridgesys.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Execution plan and signer map for MBridge DPA

Marissa — plan looks good. Quick answers:

- We can scope EU-only processing to the integration surface they described, and we can run that workload on an EU-hosted model variant. I'll confirm the technical ops runbook separately (ops will map the model endpoints to the EU pool).
- On HIPAA/BAA: MBridge's integration will be better supported on Redwood Dedicated or Private. I'll confirm which option the customer is purchasing in the order form. If they go Hosted, we'll need a more limited scoping approach.
- Please include the SOC 2 link in the DocuSign envelope as an attachment or a gated link. We have the 2025 SOC 2 report in the security bucket (link below).

Sofia — thanks for the counters. If you can confirm Director-level signatory names, Marissa will prepare DocuSign. We should be able to accept the retention compromise (90-day default + 365-day transactional carveout) as discussed, with a short exhibit listing retention by data class.

Onwards — I'll coordinate ops verification and ask engineering to validate EU-host routing.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
